?

Find the Cartesian equation of the curve defined parametrically by x=1−2t,y=(t−2)2(t+1),t∈(−∞,∞).

a
y=−18(x+3)2(x−3)
b
y=−12(x+3)2(x−3)
c
y=14(x+3)2(x−3)
d
y=18(x+3)(x−3)2
e
y=−14(x+3)(x−3)2
